web-token jwt-framework before 3.4.13, 4.0.x before 4.0.9, 4.1.x before 4.1.11, and 4.2.x before 4.2.6 allows denial of service because JWELoader and JWSLoader try every recipient or signature of a JSON General serialized token without limiting their number. Unauthenticated attackers can send a small JWE with many empty recipients inheriting a maximal PBES2 p2c value, forcing repeated key derivations that exhaust worker CPU.

In Revive Adserver through 6.0.9, an advertiser can put XML syntax in fields of its own video creative. Unescaped MediaFile attributes and CDATA terminators allow the advertiser to inject elements into VAST responses served for a publisher's zone. A crafted TrackingEvents block can suppress the ad server's video playback event records and redirect tracking requests to an attacker-controlled endpoint.

An improper authorization vulnerability exists in the patch management functionality of StellarOne. An attacker with Viewer web access can perform administrative patch management operations. This issue affects StellarOne: before 5.0.3232.

Incorrect authorization in custom storage volume, backup, and storage bucket endpoints in Canonical LXD before 5.0.12, 5.21.10, 6.10.2 allows an authenticated user with a project-restricted certificate or per-object authorization to read, rename, move, replace, or delete other projects' storage resources and bypass cluster group restrictions via missing project or object ownership checks.

Exposure of sensitive information in API responses, exports, and host-side artifacts in Canonical LXD before 5.0.12, 5.21.10, 6.10.2 allows an authenticated lower-privileged user or a local host user to read credentials, private keys, and other projects' metadata and inject arguments into Ceph administration commands via unfiltered endpoints, exported configurations, log files, process command lines, and unvalidated bucket parameters.

Incorrect authorization in instance, snapshot, and image operations in Canonical LXD before 4.0.16, 5.0.12, 5.21.10, 6.10.2 allows an authenticated user with restricted project or per-object permissions to read and modify other clients' resources and execute arbitrary code as root on the host via missing entitlement checks on secondary objects and push-mode container migrations.

VMware Avi Load Balancer contains a sensitive information disclosure vulnerability. Broadcom has evaluated the severity of the issue to be in the Low severity range with a maximum CVSSv3 base score of 3.4.
Affected versions:
VMware Avi Load Balancer 32.1.1 through 32.1.3: fixed in 32.1.4
VMware Avi Load Balancer 31.1.1 through 31.2.3: fixed in 32.1.4
VMware Avi Load Balancer 30.1.1 through 30.2.7: fixed in 32.1.4
VMware Avi Load Balancer 22.1.1 through 22.1.7: fixed in 32.1.4

In Revive Adserver through 6.0.9, the ct0 request parameter of the delivery scripts is only required to start with http:// or https:// and is prepended unescaped to banner click URLs. An unauthenticated attacker can craft a delivery URL that executes JavaScript in the delivery origin when a visitor follows it. An active banner using the raw {clickurl} macro is required.

GNU Screen is vulnerable to a Time-of-Check/Time-of-Use (TOCTOU) race condition in the hardcopy file handler. Due to checking write permissions using the real user ID and subsequently opening the file using the effective user ID, a local unprivileged attacker can atomically replace the target path with a symbolic link pointing to an arbitrary system file. Successfully exploiting this race condition allows the attacker to write to arbitrary files with root privileges, leading to local privilege escalation



This issue was fixed in version 5.0.2.
In Eclipse MWE <= 2.27.0 if you debug mwe workflows a remote attacker can cause arbitrary classes with an zero arg constructor from your mwe classpath to be instantiated in a timed attack

The CubeWP Framework plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Privilege Escalation in all versions up to, and including, 1.1.32 This is due to the `cubewp_frontend_role_caps()` function, registered on the `user_has_cap` filter, which excludes REST API requests via a `REST_REQUEST` guard but omits a corresponding `XMLRPC_REQUEST` check, causing it to unconditionally widen capabilities for any Subscriber or Contributor on XML-RPC and admin-ajax.php request paths. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers with Subscriber-level access and above to escalate their privileges to the full Contributor role capability set — gaining `edit_posts`, `delete_posts`, and `read` — allowing them to create, edit, and delete posts through core XML-RPC methods such as `wp.newPost`. Critically, the capability widening is not scoped to CubeWP's own submission handlers but applies globally to all core capability gates on affected request paths, meaning any Subscriber account can exploit this with a single standard XML-RPC call and no CubeWP-specific interaction. Successful exploitation causes the attacker's own account to receive every capability defined for the Contributor role.

The CodeColorer plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 0.12.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Successful exploitation requires that the attacker has already had one prior comment approved from the same name and email pair, as WordPress's comment_previously_approved check auto-approves subsequent comments from recognized commenters.

The Advanced Form Integration — Connect Forms to 300+ Apps plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'mapped CF7 fields (e.g. target, mkey, payload)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.11.6 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This requires an administrator to have pre-configured an AFI integration that maps all three ACF action slots (postId, selector, and value) to public form fields via the plugin's 'Use a form field…' option, which is a non-default configuration.
cves.product: Advanced Form Integration — Connect Forms to 300+ Apps

cves.description: The Classified Listing – AI-Powered Classified ads & Business Directory plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'formData[description]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 6.3.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The payload survives server-side sanitization because wp_kses_post permits span elements with class and data-* attributes; script execution is triggered only when a privileged user (Administrator or Editor) clicks the .reveal-phone span on the pending listing's preview page, causing rtcl-public.js to pass the attacker-controlled data-options value directly into jQuery.append. Successful exploitation additionally requires an action by an administrator — the attacker cannot trigger the vulnerability on their own.
cves.product: Classified Listing – AI-Powered Classified ads & Business Directory

cves.description: The (Simply) Guest Author Name plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'url' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.51 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This is only exploitable when the non-default 'Disable Guest Author for comments' plugin option is enabled and the post being viewed has a guest author assigned.

Iceburg CRM through 5.0.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows any authenticated user to modify workflows by calling the workflow save and delete endpoints. Attackers can send an empty workflow array to /data/workflow/save or call DELETE /data/workflow/{id} to wipe or rewrite the module conversion workflow.

The Email Encoder – Protect Email Addresses and Phone Numbers plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.5.5 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Exploitation requires a site administrator to have enabled the plugin's non-default "Protect custom href attributes" setting (e.g. configured to 'tel'), and injected comments must pass standard WordPress moderation before the script executes for visiting users.
cves.product: Email Encoder – Protect Email Addresses and Phone Numbers

cves.description: The Postie plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'email HTML body' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.9.91 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This is exploitable when the processing request runs under a user holding the unfiltered_html capability — either because 'Force User Login' is enabled and Postie switches to the default poster, or because an administrator manually triggers the fetch — causing wp_filter_post_kses to be stripped from content_save_pre and the attribute-breakout markup to be stored verbatim by wp_insert_post().

The SlimStat Analytics – Real-Time Stats, Heatmaps & Ecommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'HTTP_USER_AGENT' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 6.1.2 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This requires the non-default 'Show user agent' (slimstat_options[show_complete_user_agent_tooltip]) setting to be enabled, which causes the raw stored User-Agent value to be used as the tooltip title instead of a sanitized browser name.
cves.product: SlimStat Analytics – Real-Time Stats, Heatmaps & Ecommerce

cves.description: The LiteSpeed Cache plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 7.9.3 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Exploitation requires CDN Mapping to be enabled with at least one Original URLs entry containing a '*' wildcard character, a non-default configuration; the attacker's comment must also be approved, which is satisfied immediately when moderation is disabled or automatically after one prior approved comment from the same name and email address.

The Taskbuilder – Project Management & Task Management Tool With Kanban Board plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'display_name' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 7.0.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The payload fires specifically when an authenticated user with access to the Tasks admin panel applies the 'Created By' filter with the attacker-controlled user selected. Successful exploitation additionally requires an action by an administrator — the attacker cannot trigger the vulnerability on their own.
cves.product: Taskbuilder – Project Management & Task Management Tool With Kanban Board

cves.description: The Optimole – Optimize Images | Convert WebP & AVIF | CDN & Lazy Load | Image Optimization plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.2.20 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Successful exploitation requires that iframe lazy-loading is enabled (the default on new Optimole-connected installs), that the target post contains at least one iframe with fallback text, and that the attacker has had at least one prior comment approved so WordPress's default "Comment author must have a previously approved comment" setting auto-approves subsequent malicious comments.
cves.product: Optimole – Optimize Images | Convert WebP & AVIF | CDN & Lazy Load | Image Optimization

cves.description: The GeoDirectory – WP Business Directory Plugin and Classified Listings Directory plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.8.208 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Successful exploitation requires that at least one prior comment from the attacker's email address has been manually approved, which under WordPress's default comment_previously_approved=1 setting causes subsequent comments from that address to be auto-approved without moderation.
cves.product: GeoDirectory – WP Business Directory Plugin and Classified Listings Directory

cves.description: The GeoDirectory – WP Business Directory Plugin and Classified Listings Directory plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'post_content' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.8.208 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Exploitation requires an administrator to have previously configured a Shortcode-type tab whose template places %%post_content%% inside an HTML attribute, which is not a default configuration; unauthenticated exploitation additionally requires the plugin's 'Allow posting without logging in?' option and WordPress user registration to both be enabled.
cves.product: GeoDirectory – WP Business Directory Plugin and Classified Listings Directory

cves.description: The BuddyForms plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the '<form_field_slug>[] (array-valued post field)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.10.10 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This requires the BuddyForms form to have public submission enabled, which allows unauthenticated visitors to submit forms; the _wpnonce required by the form handler is printed in the public form HTML and is therefore accessible to any visitor, providing no meaningful authorization barrier.

The Optimole – Optimize Images | Convert WebP & AVIF | CDN & Lazy Load | Image Optimization plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'author' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.2.20 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This vulnerability is only reachable when the plugin's 'Enable generic placeholder color' option is disabled, as only that configuration invokes the build_url() code path that constructs $low_url from attacker-controlled input.
cves.product: Optimole – Optimize Images | Convert WebP & AVIF | CDN & Lazy Load | Image Optimization

cves.description: AzuraCast before 0.24.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in RelaysController::updateAction that allows any authenticated user to modify shared relays and delete other stations' relay associations. Attackers can POST a relay base_url to /internal/relays to rename the relay, wipe StationRemote rows of unmanaged stations, and spoof public now-playing data.

AzuraCast before 0.24.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the StationPublicApi middleware that allows any authenticated user to access non-public stations without per-station permissions. Attackers can change the station_id path parameter to list and download on-demand media, read schedule data, and submit song requests to unauthorized stations.

ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains a cross-workspace authorization bypass in the organization-users archive and unarchive endpoints, which take the target organizationId from the request body without validating it against the caller's authorized workspaces. An admin of any workspace who knows a target organization-user ID and workspace UUID can archive or unarchive users in other tenants' workspaces, locking them out of those workspaces and tampering with the audit trail.

SunEditor from 3.0.0 before 3.4.3 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the codeBlock plugin that allows attackers to inject script via entity-encoded pre language class values. Attackers can store content whose language- class decodes to HTML written via innerHTML into the hover button, executing script when victims hover over the block.

Video Popup Block by WPZOOM 1.1.2 before 1.1.9 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows Contributor-level users to inject markup via unescaped video URL and popup width values. Attackers can store a block whose .mp4 URL or width breaks out of attributes in frontend.js, executing script in the site's origin when users open the popup.

A flaw was found in Red Hat Advanced Cluster Security (ACS). An unauthenticated remote attacker can exploit a vulnerability in the login interface's OAuth callback endpoint by crafting a malicious URL. This URL, containing unvalidated `error` and `error_uri` parameters, allows the attacker to display arbitrary error messages, leading to content spoofing. Furthermore, the attacker can redirect victims to malicious domains, effectively performing an open redirect under the guise of the trusted application's user interface.

Flask-AppBuilder before 5.3.1 contains a path traversal vulnerability in ImageManager.save_file that allows authenticated users to write image files outside IMG_UPLOAD_FOLDER via unsanitized multipart filenames. Attackers with add or edit permission on a ModelView with an ImageColumn can upload filenames containing ../ segments to create or overwrite image files like static assets.

In Revive Adserver through 6.0.9, user-controlled entity names in XLS report exports can be interpreted as spreadsheet formulas. A user with permission to rename a zone can place a formula in the zone name, which is then included in another user's Conversion Tracking report. Opening the affected spreadsheet can evaluate the formula and alter displayed report contents.

The ShopMagic – email automation for WordPress plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Improper Verification of Cryptographic Signature in all versions up to, and including, 4.9.5 Although `CurrentCustomer::encode_tracking_data()` appends an md5 hash to the `shopmagic_visitor_<COOKIEHASH>` cookie to make it tamper-resistant, `CookiePersistence::get_tracking_data()` returns the raw `json_decode()`'d cookie value directly without computing or verifying that hash, leaving the cookie's `user_id`, `email`, and `meta` fields fully under attacker control. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to forge the visitor cookie — which is predictable because its name is derived as `md5(siteurl)` from the public site URL — and submit it to the unprotected `wp_ajax_nopriv_capture_email_url` endpoint (which is registered without a nonce check or capability check) to impersonate any WordPress user including administrators in ShopMagic's customer-identity context, and to overwrite the stored profile metadata — including name, phone number, and billing address — of any existing guest record in `wp_shopmagic_guest` and `wp_shopmagic_guest_meta` via `GuestManager::save()`.

The Timetics – Appointment Booking Calendar & Scheduling System plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to unauthorized modification of data and user account creation in versions up to, and including, 1.0.67 This is due to the public `POST /wp-json/timetics/v1/bookings` route being registered with `permission_callback => function () { return true; }` and the handler (`create_item()` → `save_bookings()` → `booking_appointment()`) passing the attacker-controlled `email` directly into `Customer::make()`, which (a) grants the `timetics-customer` role to any existing WordPress user matched by email — including administrators and staff — and overwrites that account's `first_name`/`last_name` user meta, and (b) calls `wp_insert_user()` with role `timetics-customer` when the email is new, regardless of the site's `users_can_register` setting. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to create arbitrary WordPress user accounts, assign the `timetics-customer` role to existing accounts (including administrators), and overwrite their profile metadata.
cves.product: Timetics – Appointment Booking Calendar & Scheduling System

cves.description: The Ultra Addons for Contact Form 7 plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to unauthorized access of data due to a missing authorization check on the UACF7_CUSTOM_FIELDS shortcode in versions up to, and including, 3.5.59 The shortcode handler accepts an attr value of the form 'post_id/meta_key', normalizes the parts with absint() and sanitize_key(), and calls get_post_meta() without verifying that the current user is authorized to read that post (no current_user_can('read_post', $id) or post_status check). This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to read arbitrary post meta, including private/draft post meta and third-party plugin PII (e.

The Maps Plugin using Google Maps for WordPress - WP Google Map plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to SQL Injection via the array keys of the `categories` entries parsed from an imported JSON file in versions up to, and including, 1.9.9 This is due to the wgm_handle_import() function sanitizing only the known-named VALUES (`name`, `icon`) of each category object while passing the attacker-controlled JSON object KEYS directly to `$wpdb->insert()`, which interpolates them as column names into the generated INSERT statement without escaping embedded backticks. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with Subscriber-level access and above (when the plugin's own 'Minimum Role for Map Editor' setting has been configured to 'Subscriber', one of five values the plugin's settings UI offers), to append additional SQL queries into already existing queries that can be used to extract sensitive information from the database, including administrator password hashes.
cves.product: Maps Plugin using Google Maps for WordPress - WP Google Map

cves.description: The MW WP Form plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Insecure Direct Object Reference in all versions up to, and including, 5.1.8 via the 'mw-wp-form_session_mw-wp-form-<FORM_ID>' parameter due to missing validation on a user controlled key. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to overwrite or delete arbitrary WordPress transients in wp_options — including core-managed transients such as wp_styles_for_blocks — enabling injection of attacker-controlled CSS into every front-end page and permanent anchoring of poisoned transient values that never re-expire. The plugin's CSRF check does not prevent exploitation because MW_WP_Form_Data::__construct() registers _save_to_session() on the PHP shutdown hook before the CSRF check runs, causing the transient write to fire even after wp_safe_redirect()+exit; the GET path via the [mwform_formkey] shortcode has no CSRF check at all.

Iceburg CRM through 5.0.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to view server configuration through public/v.php calling phpinfo(). Attackers can request v.php directly, bypassing Laravel routing, to obtain PHP version, extensions, INI settings, DOCUMENT_ROOT, and environment variables.

MISP contains an authorization flaw in the SharingGroup model's checkIfAuthorisedExtend method. The method grants sync users (those with the perm_sync role) an exemption from the extend flag requirement when modifying sharing group membership. However, this exemption was applied unconditionally to all sharing groups, including those created locally on the instance (local = 1). The intended behavior, consistent with the sync push path, is that the exemption should only apply to sharing groups received through sync from another instance (local = 0).

As a result, an authenticated sync user whose organization was a plain member (extend flag = 0) of a locally-created sharing group could add or remove organizations and servers from that group via the quick-edit actions or the edit form. This bypassed the extend-flag authorization that is required for non-owner members to modify a sharing group's membership.

Preconditions: the attacker must possess an authenticated account with the sync role (perm_sync) and the sharing group permission (perm_sharing_group), and must be a member of the target locally-created sharing group without the extend flag set. The attacker does not need to be the group owner or a site administrator.

Security impact: an unauthorized modification of sharing group membership can alter which organizations and servers are permitted to exchange threat intelligence data through that group. An attacker could add their own organization to gain access to shared indicators, or remove other organizations to disrupt their data exchange. The scope of impact is limited to the integrity of the sharing group membership configuration and does not directly expose or corrupt stored threat intelligence data.

The WP Review Slider plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Arbitrary File Read in versions up to, and including, 15.5 via the wprp_twitter_savetweet and wpfb_avatar_tolocal AJAX actions. This is due to the handlers only verifying a WordPress nonce without any current_user_can() capability check and accepting an attacker-supplied local filesystem path in the 'tw_img' parameter, which is later passed directly to PHP's copy() to write byte-identical data into a publicly accessible uploads directory under an attacker-chosen name. The nonce action 'randomnoncestring' is shared with the same vendor's companion plugin (WP Google Review Slider), which emits it to every visitor of every front-end page, making it obtainable by any logged-in user including Subscribers whenever that companion plugin is active. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to read arbitrary files on the affected site's server, including sensitive files such as wp-config.

FreeRDP before 3.33.0 contains an out-of-bounds read in the client smartcard channel because SCARD_IOCTL_LISTREADERSW decoding accepts an odd cBytes value, leaving the mszGroups wide-string buffer without an aligned NUL terminator. A malicious RDP server can send a crafted IRP_MJ_DEVICE_CONTROL request causing the client to read beyond a heap allocation, potentially crashing it.

FreeRDP from 3.0.0 before 3.33.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in cert_write_server_certificate_v1() that computes the proprietary certificate signature over a freed stream buffer after reallocation. Clients negotiating Standard RDP Security with many static channels against servers using 3072- or 4096-bit keys trigger freed heap reads, producing invalid certificate signatures.

SiYuan from 3.8.6-beta.1 before 3.8.10 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows read-only publish users (RoleReader) to modify persistent workspace configuration via /api/system/getChangelog. Attackers can send POST requests through the publish service proxy, even anonymously when basic authentication is disabled, to persist ShowChangelog = false to conf.json.

vLLM 0.3.0 before 0.30.0 contains a response amplification vulnerability in the OpenAI-compatible API server's shared RequestValidationError handler, which renders every Pydantic validation error, each of which can include the full offending input, in its HTTP 400 response. Unauthenticated attackers can send a malformed request to endpoints such as POST /v1/responses to trigger a disproportionately large error response that consumes server CPU and memory and can disrupt downstream clients and proxies.

Hono from 4.13.11 before 4.13.18 contains a middleware bypass vulnerability in serveStatic that allows unauthenticated attackers to skip prefix middleware by exploiting a second path decode when allowPercentInPath is enabled. Attackers can send malformed percent-encoded sequences so the router matches an encoded path while serveStatic serves the real file, bypassing authentication checks.

Hono from 4.12.16 before 4.13.18 contains a memory exhaustion vulnerability in the bodyLimit() middleware that retains every transfer chunk as a separate array. Unauthenticated attackers can send a within-limit request body in one-byte chunks to create millions of retained objects, terminating Bun or Node.js processes.

Hono from 4.5.1 before 4.13.18 contains a validation bypass vulnerability in validator('json') and validator('form') that allows unauthenticated attackers to skip validation by formatting Content-Type parameters differently. Attackers can add whitespace before semicolons, trailing semicolons, or underscored parameter names so validators receive empty objects while handlers still read rejected fields.

Hono from 4.13.16 before 4.13.18 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in mount() and app.mount() that forwards an incorrect path when a custom getPath adds a prefix. Unauthenticated attackers can request crafted paths that the mounted application resolves differently, reaching routes protected by path-scoped middleware such as authentication checks.

actix-http before 3.20.4 contains a response desynchronization vulnerability in its HTTP/1 client response decoder, which reads bodies on 1xx, 204 and 304 responses based on Content-Length or Transfer-Encoding headers. Servers sending such responses with framing headers cause awc clients to consume subsequent keep-alive responses, causing request failures or misattributing responses across users in proxies.

ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in QueryAuthGuard that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute queries from unreleased app versions. Attackers can POST to the data-queries run endpoint with a draft query ID from any public app to execute unpublished queries against connected datasources.

Tornado before 6.6.1 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in StaticFileHandler on Windows that allows unauthenticated attackers to read NTFS Alternate Data Streams by appending :streamname to URL paths. Attackers can request stream paths that pass the get_absolute_path and _check_in_root prefix checks to read hidden stream content, such as stored secrets or Zone.Identifier source data.

The WebP Express plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Authorization Bypass via Malformed Bcrypt Salt in all versions up to, and including, 0.25.15. This is due to insufficient validation of the attacker-supplied `salt` POST parameter in the `runAccessChecks()` function, which passes the unvalidated salt directly to PHP's `crypt()` — causing it to return an empty string when the salt contains characters outside the valid bcrypt alphabet `[./0-9A-Za-z]` — and then loosely compares the resulting empty string against the attacker-controlled `api-key-crypted` POST parameter using `==`, allowing an empty submission to match and satisfy the check. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to bypass the web service API-key authentication check and upload arbitrary image files to the cloud-conversion endpoint, where they persist at a predictable, publicly reachable path under `wp-content/webp-express/webp-images/wpc/`. The 'Require api-key to be crypted in transfer?' whitelist setting does not mitigate this bypass, as it only gates the plaintext API-key comparison branch and has no effect on the crypted-key branch containing the vulnerable logic.

Docker Sandboxes re-resolves saved mount paths when replacing a sandbox container during kit changes or restarting a sandbox. An attacker able to replace a source ancestor in a shared writable workspace with a symlink can redirect another sandbox's mount to a different host directory, exposing its contents and permitting modification through read-write mounts. The destination must remain accessible to the daemon and allowed by policy where enforced. Saved-mount replay during kit replacement was introduced in version 0.35.0; ordinary restart replay was added in version 0.45.0. This saved-mount replay issue is fixed in version 0.54.0.

A flaw was found in Keycloak. This vulnerability enables information disclosure when the parameterized-scopes feature is enabled. The protocol mapper fails to enforce authorization checks for certain scope parameter types during token and authorization requests. An authenticated remote attacker can exploit this flaw by supplying a crafted scope parameter to retrieve sensitive profile attributes of other users without authorization.

Path traversal in proxy and CDI GPU device name handling in Canonical LXD before 5.0.12, 5.21.10, and 6.10.2 allows an authenticated user with access to a restricted project permitting proxy or GPU devices to read, overwrite, or delete arbitrary host files as root and terminate host processes via crafted device names containing path traversal sequences.

Configuration injection in virtual machine disk device handling in Canonical LXD before 5.0.12, 5.21.10, 6.10.2 allows an authenticated user with VM creation permissions in a restricted project to bypass low-level VM restrictions and control the root QEMU process via quotes and line breaks in a disk device's guest path.

Exposure of sensitive information and missing requestor validation in instance, volume, and snapshot migration operations in Canonical LXD before 5.0.12, 5.21.10, 6.10.2 allows an authenticated user with project event or operation read access to read migrating configuration and filesystem data and disrupt the migration via capturing per-connection websocket secrets from operation metadata and racing the migration's data channels.

Exposure of sensitive information in live and stateful migration operations in Canonical LXD before 5.0.12, 5.21.10, 6.10.2 allows an authenticated user with project event or operation read access to read a migrating instance's checkpointed runtime state and disrupt the migration via capturing the state connection secret from operation events or queries.

Improper authentication in the guest API connection handling in Canonical LXD before 4.0.16, 5.0.12, 5.21.10, 6.10.2 allows a root user inside an unisolated instance to impersonate another instance and read its configuration, metadata, and devices across project boundaries via holding open connections across PID wrap-around.

A server-side request forgery (SSRF) flaw was found in KubeVirt's decentralized live migration. The connectURL field of a VirtualMachineInstanceMigration object is not validated at admission, and the privileged synchronization-controller dials the attacker-specified URL. Connection and DNS errors from the dial are exposed in a condition readable in the tenant's namespace. A user with the kubevirt.io:migrate role (a role designed for tenant delegation) can use this behavior as a blind network-reconnaissance oracle to determine the existence and connectivity of internal hosts and ports from the controller's network vantage, including services isolated from the tenant by network policy. TLS certificate pinning prevents session completion with non-KubeVirt hosts, limiting the impact to information disclosure of internal network topology; no data content, integrity, or availability impact is possible.

The AutomatorWP – No-Code Workflow Automation, Integration & Webhooks Plugin, now with AI plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to generic SQL Injection via the 'post_field_conditions[0][field]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 6.1.2 due to insufficient escaping on the user supplied parameter and lack of sufficient preparation on the existing SQL query. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with administrator-level access and above, to append additional SQL queries into already existing queries that can be used to extract sensitive information from the database. The vulnerability requires a two-step exploit: a crafted field value must first be stored via the wp_ajax_automatorwp_update_item_option AJAX endpoint, and then the target automation must be triggered to fire the vulnerable SQL query.
cves.product: AutomatorWP – No-Code Workflow Automation, Integration & Webhooks Plugin, now with AI

cves.description: vLLM 0.16.0 before 0.21.0 leaks token data between users when the V1 model runner uses async scheduling with pipeline parallelism, because non-last pipeline ranks never write generated tokens to token_ids_cpu and reset num_tokens_no_spec each step. When the fallback path is triggered, such as by mixed prefill/decode batches, stale tokens from a prior request in the same batch slot become model input and are written to the KV cache, exposing fragments of one user's context in another user's response.

web-token jwt-framework before 3.4.13, 4.0.0 before 4.0.9, 4.1.0 before 4.1.11, and 4.2.0 before 4.2.6 does not check oct key length in the AESKW, AESGCMKW, and experimental AESCTR and chacha20-poly1305 key encryption algorithms, so OpenSSL zero-pads short or empty keys. When an application uses an empty key, anyone can unwrap content encryption keys under the all-zero key to read issued tokens and forge accepted ones.

A weakness has been identified in sgl-project SpecForge 0.2.0. This impacts the function Eagle3DraftModel.load_embedding of the file specforge/modeling/draft/base.py of the component Draft Embedding Loader. Executing a manipulation can lead to path traversal. The attack can only be executed locally. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. This patch is called d8a0d78e071199563ef19d9171052096dec89f71. It is advisable to implement a patch to correct this issue.

An improper version validation vulnerability exists in the product update mechanism of StellarProtect Linux and Stellar Agent (Linux). An attacker with product admin privileges can downgrade the product to an older, potentially vulnerable version, potentially allowing previously patched vulnerabilities to be reintroduced and security protections to be weakened. This issue affects StellarProtect Linux: 1.0 and earlier; Stellar Agent (Linux): before 1.2.54. *Note: Stellar Agent (Linux) is the new name for StellarProtect Linux.

The Ultra Addons for Contact Form 7 plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'dfile (any CF7 file field)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.5.58 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Successful script execution additionally requires a web server that returns no explicit Content-Type header for the targeted audio/video extension, causing the browser to sniff and render the uploaded file as text/html; default Apache configurations without mod_headers or without honoring .htaccess satisfy this condition. Successful exploitation additionally requires an action by an administrator — the attacker cannot trigger the vulnerability on their own.

The Mail2000 developed by Openfind has a Reflected Cross-site Scripting vulnerability. Unauthenticated remote attackers can execute arbitrary JavaScript code in user's browser through phishing attacks.

GNU screen is vulnerable to a global buffer overflow in the SendCmdMessage() function within attacher.c. Due to the use of an unchecked sprintf() call when appending the STY environment variable to the global SocketPath buffer. The vulnerability occurs when GNU screen is executed in an environment where the HOME and STY environment variables contain attacker-controlled values that are sufficiently long. Successful exploitation may result in an application crash or potentially arbitrary code execution.


This issue was fixed in version 5.0.2.

Coder before 2.29.27, 2.30.0 before 2.34.19, 2.35.0 before 2.37.11, and 2.38.0 before 2.38.7 does not validate the URL scheme of the agent-supplied uri field in app status updates, which the dashboard renders as a clickable link. An attacker holding a workspace agent token, including a prompt-injected AI agent, can show workspace or task viewers links that send them to phishing sites or non-web applications.

Frappe Framework before 15.119.0 and 16.x before 16.32.0 does not neutralize spreadsheet formula elements in user-supplied data included in CSV and XLSX exports, resulting in stored formula injection. Authenticated attackers can store crafted values that are interpreted as formulas when another user opens the exported file in a spreadsheet application.

The Funnelforms Free – Multi Step Form, Contact Form & Lead Funnel Builder plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'document.settings.heading' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 5.0.9 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with administrator-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This is exploitable on standard single-site WordPress installs only when the DISALLOW_UNFILTERED_HTML constant is set, the site is a WordPress multisite network (where administrators lack the unfiltered_html capability by default), or an administrator has explicitly granted the funnelforms_edit_forms capability to a lower-privileged role. Exploitation by attackers with administrator-level access and above requires that the site is a WordPress multisite install (site admins automatically lack unfiltered_html). On a default installation, where that is not configured, the vulnerability requires attackers with custom-level access and above.
cves.product: Funnelforms Free – Multi Step Form, Contact Form & Lead Funnel Builder

cves.description: web-token jwt-framework from 4.2.1 before 4.2.6 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that exposes decryption keys in exception stack traces when JWE tokens are rejected. Attackers can submit crafted JWE tokens so JWELoader and JWEDecrypter record dir, AES key wrapping, PBES2-derived or content encryption keys in logged trace arguments readable by others.

A security flaw has been discovered in RT-Thread up to 5.3.0. Affected is the function davinci_spi_get_prescale of the file bsp/dm365/drivers/spi-davinci.c of the component DM365 SPI Driver. The manipulation of the argument max_hz results in divide by zero. The attack requires a local approach. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. The patch is identified as e12183f7b87eddf182b95bf8b400acd626880306. Applying a patch is advised to resolve this issue.

The Product Options and Price Calculation Formulas for WooCommerce – Uni CPO plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'price_disabled_msg' setting in versions up to, and including, 4.9.69 The uni_cpo_save_settings_data() AJAX handler applies html_entity_decode() to the output of uni_cpo_sanitize_text(), which itself already runs html_entity_decode() before wp_kses(); this double decode allows a double-entity-encoded tag to pass wp_kses as inert text and then be re-materialised as live HTML before being stored in the _cpo_price_disabled_msg post meta and later echoed via do_shortcode() on the single-product page without further escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with Shop Manager-level access (edit_products) and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected product page.
cves.product: Product Options and Price Calculation Formulas for WooCommerce – Uni CPO

cves.description: The WordClever – AI Content Writer plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to authorization bypass in all versions up to, and including, 1.1.5. This is due to the plugin not properly verifying that a user is authorized to perform an action. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to overwrite and permanently destroy the administrator's license configuration, blanking the stored license key, setting the license status to inactive, and clearing the current plan — disabling the plugin's paid AI generation features site-wide.

The GamiPress – Gamification plugin to reward points, badges & ranks in WordPress, now with AI plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Sensitive Information Exposure in all versions up to, and including, 8.1.7 via the 'access' parameter. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to extract private GamiPress log entries belonging to other users, including admin award, revoke, and event-trigger records marked as private.
cves.product: GamiPress – Gamification plugin to reward points, badges & ranks in WordPress, now with AI

cves.description: The Xagio SEO & AEO – AI SEO for Google Rankings & AI Visibility plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to authorization bypass in all versions up to, and including, 7.1.0.54 This is due to the plugin not properly verifying that a user is authorized to perform an action. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to modify the XAGIO_SEO_SEARCH_PREVIEW_ENABLE post meta on arbitrary posts, disabling the plugin's SEO title and meta description output for those posts.
cves.product: Xagio SEO & AEO – AI SEO for Google Rankings & AI Visibility

cves.description: The WPFunnels – Funnel Builder for WooCommerce with Checkout & One Click Upsell plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to sensitive information disclosure in versions up to, and including, 3.13.8 This is due to the wpfnl_register_dashboard_widgets() function registering the 'WPFunnels Overview' dashboard widget on the wp_dashboard_setup hook with no capability check on either the registration or the wpfnl_dashboard_overview_widget() callback, which queries the wpfnl_stats and wpfnl_optin_entries tables and echoes the store's completed-order count, total revenue, order-bump revenue, upsell/downsell revenue and total lead/optin count directly into the dashboard. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above (contributor-level on sites running WooCommerce, where WC_Admin::prevent_admin_access() blocks subscribers from reaching /wp-admin/index.
cves.product: WPFunnels – Funnel Builder for WooCommerce with Checkout & One Click Upsell

cves.description: The Premium Packages - Sell Digital Products Securely plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Insecure Direct Object Reference in versions up to, and including, 7.3.4 This is due to the cancel_subscription(), toggleAutoRenew() and toggleManualRenew() AJAX handlers performing no ownership or capability check on the user-supplied `orderid` parameter — the only gate is a plugin-wide NONCE_KEY nonce that is emitted to any visitor on every product page. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to cancel other customers' subscriptions, flip `auto_renew` and toggle the `manual_renew` meta on any order by supplying its ID.
cves.product: Premium Packages - Sell Digital Products Securely

cves.description: A security flaw has been discovered in nirix Traq 3.9.0-beta.1. Affected by this issue is the function createSession of the file src/Traq/Controllers/UserController.php of the component Login Handler. Performing a manipulation of the argument redirect results in open redirect. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

Golift xtractr before 0.4.1 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows attackers to write files outside the extraction root because a strings.HasPrefix output directory check lacks separator awareness. Attackers can supply ZIP, TAR, 7z, RAR, or other archives with entries like ../<outputdir>_evil/file to create or overwrite files in sibling directories.

KodeRover Zadig before 5.1.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in aslan environment kube.go handlers that allows authenticated users to query Kubernetes clusters of other projects. Attackers can supply arbitrary clusterID and namespace values to /api/aslan/environment/kube/ routes to enumerate namespaces, nodes, deployments, workloads, canary mappings, and resource names.

Iceburg CRM through 5.0.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the related_fields and related_field_name routes in routes/data.php that lets authenticated users read restricted module data. Attackers can enumerate field_id values to query related module tables without Permission::checkPermission checks, reading id and name pairs such as user names from ice_users.

Listmonk 4.1.0 through 7.0.0-beta.2 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in CSV subscriber import that allows list-scoped users to overwrite subscribers outside their permitted lists. Attackers holding subscribers:import and list:manage on one list can import CSV rows with victims' emails and overwrite enabled to modify names, attributes, and list memberships.

Iceburg CRM through 5.0.0 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability that allows authenticated users to exhaust disk space by uploading files to the POST /data/import route. Attackers without import permission can repeatedly upload input_file payloads that are stored in storage/app/temp and parsed before permission checks, never deleted, causing denial of service.

A vulnerability was identified in SourceCodester Online Food Ordering System 1.0. This impacts an unknown function of the file food-search.php of the component Food Search. The manipulation of the argument Search leads to cross site scripting. The attack may be initiated remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used.

A weakness has been identified in SourceCodester Syllabus-Aligned Learning Management & Examination System 1.0. Affected by this vulnerability is an unknown functionality of the file approve_enrollment.php. This manipulation causes open redirect. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks.

SurrealDB before 4.0.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows authenticated users to read SELECT-hidden edge endpoints through InOverride/OutOverride error messages. Attackers with CREATE and UPDATE permission on an edge table can re-RELATE an existing edge with mismatched endpoints to recover stored in/out record ids despite row- or field-level restrictions.

SurrealDB before 4.0.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the remote HTTP client router that passes raw model names to Url::join during ML export. Attackers can supply an absolute URL as the model name in ExportMl or ExportBytesMl commands to redirect authenticated requests and capture session tokens.

ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS is missing the ValidateDataSourceGuard on the dependent-queries route of the data-sources controller and does not scope the datasource lookup to the caller's organization. An authenticated admin or builder with dataSourceDelete can request /api/data-sources/dependent-queries/<datasource_uuid> to confirm a datasource exists in another organization and learn its dependent-query count.

ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated same-organization users to invoke OAuth2 authorization on data sources they cannot configure. Attackers can send POST requests to /api/data-sources/:id/authorize_oauth2 to bind attacker-controlled OAuth credentials or overwrite token state for foreign data sources.

ToolJet before 3.21.94-beta contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in getVersionsByEnvironment that allows authenticated users to read another organization's application versions due to missing organizationId scoping. Attackers can request the app-environments versions route with their own priority-1 production environment id and a victim app_id to retrieve the victim's version list and structure.

LaraDashboard before 1.5.2 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the QuickDraft Livewire component that allows any authenticated user to create posts without the post.create permission. Attackers such as self-registered Subscriber accounts can submit the dashboard Quick Draft widget to inject draft posts, bypassing the PostPolicy check enforced by PostController.

A vulnerability was detected in ONNX ONNXMLTools up to 1.16.0. This affects the function get_set_node of the file onnxmltools/utils/visualize.py of the component Model Visualization. The manipulation results in cross site scripting. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. The pull request to fix this issue awaits acceptance.

A flaw has been found in ONNX ONNXMLTools up to 1.16.0. This impacts the function visualize_model of the file onnxmltools/utils/visualize.py. This manipulation of the argument producer_name causes basic cross site scripting. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. The pull request to fix this issue awaits acceptance.

A flaw was found in the keycloak-services component of Keycloak, which is used to handle OpenID Connect authentication flows. The issue occurs because the security check that prevents attackers from pre-seeding security parameters in a redirect URL can be bypassed by adding an extra question mark character to the parameter name. This allows an attacker to trick a user's browser into using an attacker-controlled login code. As a result, a victim may be unknowingly logged into an attacker's account, leading to account confusion or the exposure of sensitive data entered by the victim.

In Revive Adserver through 6.0.9, deleting an agency, advertiser, or publisher through affected API paths can leave the associated account and user session active because the deletion path does not load the entity's account identifier before cleanup. A user whose entity has been deleted can continue accessing pages of the orphaned account. Access to data belonging to another agency was not demonstrated.
Rejected reason: This CVE has been rejected by Upstream. Ref: https://bugzilla.samba.org/show_bug.cgi?id=16047#c4

A flaw was found in the SAML identity brokering component of Keycloak. When Keycloak is configured to use a database with case-insensitive collation, it may incorrectly match a SAML subject name to an existing user account if the names differ only by case. This issue allows an attacker to log in as a different user by providing a case-distinct version of a victim's username in a signed SAML assertion, leading to unauthorized account access.

Allocation of resources without limits or throttling vulnerability in Apache SkyWalking BanyanDB.



Uncontrolled resource consumption in Apache SkyWalking BanyanDB's query API allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to cause the server to exhaust memory and terminate. A query request can specify an arbitrarily large result limit and offset, which the server uses to pre-allocate result buffers without an upper bound; a single request may force an allocation of tens of gigabytes and cause the process to be killed



This issue affects Apache SkyWalking BanyanDB: from 0.11.0 before 0.11.1.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 0.11.1, which fixes the issue.

The Apache Airflow TaskFlow decorators @task.bash, @task.sql, @task.analytics, @task.kubernetes_cmd and the common.ai decorators (@task.llm, @task.agent, @task.llm_sql, @task.llm_branch, @task.llm_file_analysis, @task.llm_schema_compare) rendered Jinja templates a second time after the task runner had already rendered them, so any value copied into env, op_args, op_kwargs or the returned prompt, command or SQL was evaluated as a template on the worker. An attacker who can only trigger a Dag run (for example a user with trigger permission supplying run conf), or who controls text that a Dag passes into one of these decorators as an argument or prompt (for example a ticket or a downloaded document), could run arbitrary commands on the worker and read connection passwords and Variables, in any deployment that uses an affected decorator in a Dag that passes such input through env, parameters or prompt. Users are recommended to upgrade apache-airflow-providers-standard to 1.22.0, apache-airflow-providers-cncf-kubernetes to 11.0.0, apache-airflow-providers-common-sql to 3.0.0 and apache-airflow-providers-common-ai to 1.2.0 or later.
Rejected reason: This CVE ID has been rejected or withdrawn by its CVE Numbering Authority.

A flaw was found in rsyslog. This vulnerability allows a local user to spoof sender identity and cause downstream log consumers to misattribute event origins. When the imuxsock module is configured with plain trusted-property annotation, it fails to properly escape process names and executable paths in log metadata. A local attacker can exploit this issue by sending log messages through the local log socket with crafted process names to inject forged identity attributes.

GNU mtools through 4.0.50 contains a divide-by-zero vulnerability that allows attackers to crash mtools commands by supplying a FAT image with a zero sectors-per-cluster byte. Attackers can craft a FAT image that, when opened with mdir, minfo or mtype, triggers a SIGFPE in calc_num_clus() on x86, causing denial of service.

An HTML injection vulnerability exists in the alert notification functionality of StellarOne due to improper sanitization of agent-supplied data. An attacker controlling an agent identity can submit crafted HTML content, potentially allowing the attacker to manipulate displayed content or deceive recipients. This issue affects StellarOne: before 5.0.3232.

Traefik before 2.11.62, 3.x before 3.7.18, and 3.8.0-rc.1 before 3.8.0-rc.2 contain a denial of service vulnerability in the BasicAuth middleware, which does not limit password length before MD5-crypt ($apr1$, $1$) hashing. Unauthenticated attackers can send passwords up to the entry point maxHeaderBytes limit (1 MiB by default), consuming excessive CPU per request and degrading availability.

web-token jwt-framework and jwt-library before 3.4.13, 4.0.0 before 4.0.9, 4.1.0 before 4.1.11, and 4.2.0 before 4.2.6 contain a decryption oracle in RSACrypt::decryptWithRSAOAEP(), which accepts a JWE Encrypted Key made of multiple RSA blocks instead of a single RSAES-OAEP ciphertext. Attackers holding the recipient's public key can embed a captured encrypted key among crafted blocks and, using an accepted AES-CBC-HMAC algorithm and a decryption success signal, recover its CEK byte by byte to decrypt the captured JWE.

ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated users to read cross-workspace files by requesting a known File UUID. Attackers can request GET /api/files/:id with another workspace's File UUID to retrieve stored file bytes, such as avatars, without parent resource authorization checks.

ImageMagick 7.0.0 before 7.1.2-35 and before 6.9.13-60 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in the distributed pixel cache server, which transmits pixel and metadata content in cleartext. Attackers who can observe traffic between a DPC client and server can read transmitted image data.

A security vulnerability has been detected in GH05TCREW PentestAgent 0.2.0. This vulnerability affects the function _execute_single of the file pentestagent/agents/base_agent.py of the component Workspace Scope Gate. Such manipulation leads to missing authorization. The attack needs to be performed locally. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

A weakness has been identified in RT-Thread up to 5.3.0. Affected by this vulnerability is the function bl_adc_get_value of the file bsp/bouffalo_lab/libraries/rt_drivers/drv_adc.c of the component Bouffalo ADC Driver. This manipulation of the argument channel causes improper validation of array index. The attack requires local access. Patch name: b3a0eb5e12c6dca8145fc49d76c4785478c9e55b. It is suggested to install a patch to address this issue.

The Fluent Forms – Customizable Contact Forms, Survey, Quiz, & Conversational Form Builder plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Account Pre-Hijacking via Unverified Identifier in all versions up to, and including, 6.2.15. The vulnerability exists because the `PaymentHandler::maybeAssignTransactions()` function, registered on the `user_register` hook at priority 99, resolves the lookup email solely from the newly created user record via the `user_email` parameter with no prior verification that the registrant actually controls that address, then bulk-updates all guest transactions and submissions in `wp_fluentform_transactions` and `wp_fluentform_submissions` whose `payer_email` matches and whose `user_id` is NULL to assign ownership to the attacker's new account. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to pre-hijack a victim's prior guest payment history — reading their payment receipts and cancelling their active subscriptions via the `[fluentform_payments]` shortcode and the `wp_ajax_fluentform_user_payment_endpoints` `cancel_transaction` route — by simply registering an account under the victim's email address before the legitimate owner does. Exploitation requires that the WordPress site has open user registration enabled and that the targeted victim previously submitted at least one payment as a guest under their email address.
cves.product: Fluent Forms – Customizable Contact Forms, Survey, Quiz, & Conversational Form Builder

cves.description: vLLM 0.21.0 before 0.28.0, when using the V1 model runner, contains a state aliasing flaw in ThinkingBudgetStateHolder.sync_batch(), whose SWAP branch copies thinking-budget state to the destination batch row without removing the source entry. Attackers submitting requests with thinking_token_budget can force the reasoning-end token sequence into a concurrent co-batched request's output during a mixed batch reorder.

Web-Token jwt-framework and jwt-library before 3.4.13, 4.0.0 before 4.0.9, 4.1.0 before 4.1.11, and 4.2.0 before 4.2.6, and jwt-encryption through 3.2.10, contain a token malleability flaw because JWEDecrypter does not reject a non-empty JWE Encrypted Key with the dir, ECDH-ES and ECDH-SS algorithms, which the authentication tag does not cover. Attackers holding one token can fill the Encrypted Key with arbitrary bytes to derive unlimited distinct token strings that still decrypt, bypassing replay caches, single-use registries or revocation deny-lists keyed on the token string.

LibreChat 0.7.8 before 0.8.9 contains a race condition vulnerability in checkBalance that allows authenticated users to obtain multiple auto-refill credits by sending concurrent requests. Attackers can send simultaneous chat requests that each pass the unlocked lastRefill check, receiving repeated refillAmount credits and bypassing configured token credit limits.

GNU Screen is vulnerable to a Use-After-Free in the utf8_handle_comb() function in encoding.c. Due to improper error handling during memory allocation failure, the global combchars pointer is freed but not reset to NULL. When a subsequent combining Unicode character arrives at the terminal, the function dereferences the freed pointer. An attacker who controls terminal content sent to the screen session, such as via a rogue SSH server or crafted escape sequences, can exploit this vulnerability to perform heap grooming and achieve arbitrary code execution.



This issue was fixed in version 5.0.2.

Relative Path Traversal vulnerability in ex-aws ex_aws_lambda (ExAws.Lambda module) allows an attacker to redirect an AWS Lambda control-plane request at an unintended resource by injecting path traversal sequences into a caller-supplied identifier.

This vulnerability is associated with program file lib/ex_aws/lambda.ex and program routines ExAws.Lambda.add_permission/5, ExAws.Lambda.delete_event_source_mapping/1, ExAws.Lambda.delete_function/1, ExAws.Lambda.get_event_source_mapping/1, ExAws.Lambda.get_function/1, ExAws.Lambda.get_function_configuration/1, ExAws.Lambda.get_policy/1, ExAws.Lambda.invoke/4, ExAws.Lambda.invoke_async/2, ExAws.Lambda.remove_permission/2, ExAws.Lambda.update_event_source_mapping/2, ExAws.Lambda.update_function_code/2, ExAws.Lambda.update_function_configuration/2.

ExAws.Lambda builds every request path by interpolating caller-supplied identifiers (function names, ARNs, UUIDs, statement IDs) directly into the URL with plain string interpolation, without percent-encoding or validation. The shared request helper only encodes query parameters, never the path, so path metacharacters such as / and .. reach the wire unchanged. An application that passes an untrusted or user-influenced identifier into an ExAws.Lambda operation can therefore have its request steered at a different Lambda resource: a ../ segment climbs out of the intended /2015-03-31/functions/<name> slot and, once the .. is normalized by the HTTP client or the AWS endpoint, addresses a sibling function in the same account. The signed credentials and the HTTP method are unchanged, so the request still succeeds against the wrong resource. Affected operations include function deletion, invocation, configuration updates, and permission changes. Applications that only pass hardcoded or strictly validated identifiers are not affected.

This issue affects ex_aws_lambda: from 2.0.1 before 2.2.0.

The Android application "Tokyo Fire Department Official App" contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows a malicious application installed on a user's device to obtain sensitive information from the affected application.
